description: This file defines the `BuzzPost` class, which represents a social media post or message within the OrangeHRM's buzz (internal social network) plugin. It includes properties such as the post ID, authoring employee, text content, timestamps, and associated photos and links. The class also has relevant methods for accessing and mutating its properties.

classes.name: BuzzPost
classes.description: Entity class representing a post in the internal social feed, with properties for content, author, timestamps, photos, and links.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the BuzzPost.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the BuzzPost.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee who authored the post.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity as the author of the post.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text content of the post.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text content of the post.

methods.name: getCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the post in UTC.

methods.name: setCreatedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp to the current UTC time.

methods.name: getUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the last updated timestamp in UTC, if available.

methods.name: setUpdatedAtUtc
methods.description: Updates the last updated timestamp to the current UTC time.
